subject.title: Bug: OpenClaw 2026.4.9 exposes agent internal thinking (English) to user

question: Should this security-sensitive sanitizer gap be fixed by a maintainer-owned patch now, or should ClawSweeper be allowed to queue a narrow repair despite the current no-new-fix-pr/security-review labels?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear and narrow, but it concerns exposure of internal reasoning to external chat recipients and the item is already marked for security-sensitive maintainer review.

options.title: Maintainer-owned narrow fix
options.body: A maintainer patches the shared/embedded scanner boundary and validates the source-level and channel-delivery cases before clearing the security labels.

options.title: Approve ClawSweeper repair
options.body: A maintainer explicitly permits an automated narrow fix PR limited to the embedded/shared tag scanner and regression tests.

options.title: Defer under current labels
options.body: Keep the issue open without a repair job until security owners decide the delivery and reasoning-visibility policy.

recommendation.title: Maintainer-owned narrow fix
recommendation.body: A maintainer patches the shared/embedded scanner boundary and validates the source-level and channel-delivery cases before clearing the security labels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared sanitizer and embedded-agent history makes this the best available routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
